title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: In one high-nuclearity nickel-POM series, reported hydrogen-evolution turnover numbers increased with the number of Ni4O4 cubane units.
explanation: The three compared POM clusters were reported with increasing turnover numbers of 578.8, 679.1, and 931.1 as the number of cubane units increased.
scope: The three nickel-POM hydrogen-evolution catalysts compared in Section 3.3.
caveats: Other compositional and structural features also vary among the compounds, so cubane count should not be treated as an independently proven universal causal variable.
